question.text: Which of the following factors is NOT typically considered while risk profiling a PMS investor?

explanation.text: The Logic: Risk profiling considers financial and risk-tolerance factors such as age, financial goals, investment experience, liquidity needs, income stability, net worth, and psychological risk tolerance. The Trap: Past residential addresses are not listed among PMS risk-profiling factors. Note: Source-listed risk-profiling factors do not include past residential addresses.
